summary.text: Andy Josephson has served in the Alaska House of Representatives for District 13 since 2013.

paragraphs.text: Josephson's legislative biography lists the occupation as attorney and says Josephson was born in Anchorage; it lists a B.A. in history from Whitman College (1986), a master's in teaching from the University of Alaska Anchorage (1992) and a J.D. from Penn State Dickinson School of Law (1997).

Earlier work listed there includes teaching in the Kuspuk School District, serving as an assistant district attorney in Kotzebue from 1999 to 2001, and teaching constitutional law at the University of Alaska Anchorage.
